description: Implementation of the recommendations of the Committee appointed to review the Recruitment Process and Cadre Management in the Public Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- An Officials' Committee has been appointed under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Prime Minister to review the recruitment process in the Public Service and identify the needs, priorities, and time frames and take necessary action regarding the recruitments to be essentially made relating thereto. Taking into account the requests made to the said Committee by the respective Ministries to fill the vacancies in the departments and other institutions falling thereunder, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister to make the following recruitments as per the recommendations made at the meeting of the said Officials' Committee held on 2025-11-14:
